Definition: Chushim, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hushim = "who makes haste"; n pr f; 1) one of the two wives of Shaharaim; n pr m; 2) the sons of Aher, a Benjamite; 3) descendants of Dan
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
